title: Niagara Falls Night Tour with Journey Behind Falls and Fireworks
blurb:
Experience Niagara Falls at night on an unforgettable guided walking tour filled with iconic attractions and breathtaking views. Your evening begins at the Skylon Tower, where you’ll meet your expert guide before heading toward the Falls via the scenic Incline Railway.

 Descend deep into the rock at Journey Behind the Falls and step onto observation decks just feet from the powerful Horseshoe Falls, dramatically illuminated against the night sky. Feel the mist, hear the roar, and witness one of the world’s most famous natural wonders from a truly unique perspective.

 Continue with a guided walk along the Niagara Parkway, taking in stunning views of the Horseshoe, American, and Bridal Veil Falls as they glow in vibrant colors.

 End your evening at the Illumination Tower, where you’ll have the rare opportunity to control the lighting of the Falls yourself. Timed with the nightly fireworks, this immersive experience offers the perfect way to see Niagara Falls come alive after dark.
